授業概要
In this lecture series, we will explore and debate the fundamental questions of the sustainable built environment: what kind of urban (or rural) life do we want? and how to achieve sustainability of the built environment? from multiple perspectives.
This course is structured into two distinct units, each addressing key aspects of sustainable built environments:
UNIT 2. RESOURCE AND ENERGY-EFFICIENT BUILDINGS AND CITIES
This unit covers the concepts and practices of designing and constructing buildings and cities that minimize the use of natural resources and energy. It introduces the principles of sustainability, green building, passive design, renewable energy, renewable materials, and better construction methods. It also explores the challenges and opportunities for implementing resource-efficient and energy-efficient solutions in different contexts and scales.
